1981-2415-7272-8175.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
1981-2415-7272-8175.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Edgar and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Edgar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

69-539-1719-3172.easyPrerequisites:
Forests and green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
Thespian's Stage and Vizier of Tumbling Sands do not have summoning sickness.
69-539-1719-3172.description:
Activate all Forests and all mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Thespian's Stage's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of Patron of the Orochi.
Put Patron of the Orochi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Thespian's Stage.
Activate Thespian's Stage using Patron of the Orochi's ability by tapping it, untapping all Forests and all green creatures.
Activate all Forests and all mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Thespian's Stage using its own ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of itself, which causes it to become a copy of Patron of the Orochi.
Repeat from step 4.
69-539-1719-3172.notes: If Forests and/or green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}, this combo nets infinite mana.

2724-7843-8172.description:
Activate Elrond by paying {5}{U}{U}, exiling and returning (at end step) Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Wormfang Manta entering does not cause its abillity to trigger due to Karn.
Repeat each turn.

1981-2415-4050-7399.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-4050-7399.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

4153-5641-5805.easyPrerequisites: At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
4153-5641-5805.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

997-4364-7917.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
997-4364-7917.description:
Declare Aurelia and Seluma as attackers. Aurelia triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Aurelia.
Deal combat damage using Seluma. Seluma triggers, returning Aurelia from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

1479-5033-7885.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
1479-5033-7885.description:
Play any land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce {1}.
When the land enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Down in the Valley trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Down in the Valley trigger, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers.
Holding priority, activate the land played in step 1 by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Down in the Valley triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 5.

2092-3861-4954.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has at least 7 power.
2092-3861-4954.description:
Activate Orzhov Basilica by tapping it, adding two mana.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {1}, untapping Orzhov Basilica and causing it to become an 8/8 Elemental with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may tap and untap any other land(s) you control, and if you control lands that can produce {R} and {G}, use the mana to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

1621-6867-6967-7055.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

215-539-1526-7781.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures.
215-539-1526-7781.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Cast Woodcaller Automaton for its prototype cost by paying {2}{G}{G}.
When Woodcaller Automaton enters, it triggers, untapping Circle of Dreams Druid
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Woodcaller Automaton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1368-4289-6321-7730.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-4289-6321-7730.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1061-1576-7715.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} the first turn, with {3}{U}{U}{U} available each extra turn
1061-1576-7715.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
You have an effect that grants Timestream Navigator haste each turn.
1061-1576-7715.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mighty Thor triggers, blinking Forerunner of the Coalition.
Forerunner of the Coalition enters, triggering its first ability, causing you to search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it on top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Timestream Navigator during your draw phase.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Timestream Navigator enters the battlefield, triggering Forerunner of the Coalition's second ability, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

2103-7638-7722.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using The Mind Stone.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

232-5778-6441-6867.description:
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying its mana cost plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, its innate ability and its offspring ability trigger.
Resolve the innate Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}
Resolve the offspring trigger, creating two token copies of Priest of Urabrask that are 1/1.
When the Priest of Urabrask tokens enter, they each trigger, adding six {R}.
Cast Appa by paying its mana cost plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Appa enters, its innate ability and its offspring ability trigger.
Resolve the innate Appa trigger, airbending the nontoken Priest of Urabrask.
Resolve the offspring trigger, creating two token copies of Appa that are 1/1.
Put both Appa tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Both Appa tokens' enter-the-battlefield ability trigger, airbending Appa with one trigger and nothing with the other.
Cast Priest of Urabrask from exile by paying {2} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
Repeat steps 2 through 5 once.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {2} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
Repeat from step 7.
232-5778-6441-6867.notes: Once you have extra mana, other nonland permanents can be airbended using Appa and returned to the battlefield each loop as desired.

1824-2530-3168-7350.manaNeeded: {B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1824-2530-3168-7350.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-3168-7350.description:
Cast Acererak either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Demon's Horn triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

1479-2841-5702-6156.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bad River.
1479-2841-5702-6156.description:
Fetch a land using Bad River.
When the fetched land enters, Springheart Nantuko and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

730-1479-2841-6157.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bant Panorama.
730-1479-2841-6157.description:
Fetch a land using Bant Panorama.
When the fetched land enters, Emeria Angel and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Emeria Angel trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Angel from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Emeria Angel triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

7-4594-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-4594-7070.description:
Activate Spirit en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Spirit en-Kor.
The Spirit en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Spirit en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Hamza.
Repeat.

465-3742-4251-5929-7060.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

2457-4094-4289-7060.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2

3558-3967-4053-6989.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

225-1409-2895-3147.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
225-1409-2895-3147.description:
Cast Uro by paying {1}{G}{U}
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger, as well as Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Uro.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to draw a card, gain 3 life, and put Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Azorius Chancery.
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{U}.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Uro by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Simic Ragworm

129-1562-3812.description:
Activate Machine God's Effigy by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Machine God's Effigy by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
129-1562-3812.notes: Simic Ragworm can be in any zone so long as Machine God's Effigy is on the battlefield as a copy of it.

647-2105-6911.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Combat Celebrant has vigilance.
647-2105-6911.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks and triggering its ability, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Combat Celebrant, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that isn't legendary.
During your next combat phase, declare Combat Celebrant and the Combat Celebrant token as attackers, choosing to exert the Combat Celebrant token as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant token triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

339-677-5256-6633.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

176-5522-6797.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one other non-Spirit creature.
176-5522-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing any other non-Spirit creature.
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token that enters the battlefield as a copy of Essence of the Wild.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

856-997-5631-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Skeleton Crew trigger.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

11-4872-5131-6276.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
11-4872-5131-6276.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Time Warp.
Holding priority, activate Slick Imitator by paying {1} and sacrificing it, copying Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the original Narset's Reversal targeting Time Warp, and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Slick Imitator from your graveyard by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.
11-4872-5131-6276.notes: If you've cast a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn, you may move to your extra turn, and then do step 6 followed by steps 1-5.

678-3129-5296.description:
Cast Workhorse by paying {6}, causing it to enter the battlefield with eight +1/+1 counters on it due to Primal Vigor.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 until Workhorse has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Workhorse dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Enduring Renewal, returning Workhorse from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1309-1799-2579-2701-4050.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Salvager of Secrets, adding one mana of any color.
When Salvager of Secrets dies, The Cauldron of Eternity triggers, putting Salvager of Secrets from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Salvager of Secrets from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Grenzo's ability any number of times.

401-1778-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
401-1778-4050.description:
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Memnite, adding {1}.
When Memnite dies, Decaying Soil triggers, causing you to pay {1} to return Memnite to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

3718-5194.notablePrerequisites: You control an indestructible noncreature permanent.
3718-5194.description:
Cast Chain of Acid by paying {3}{G}, targeting an indestructible noncreature permanent you control.
Dragonsguard Elite triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Chain of Acid, destroying nothing and causing you to copy Chain of Acid, targeting an indestructible noncreature permanent you control.
Repeat from step 2.

678-1636-1778-4534.notablePrerequisites: Barrage Ogre does not have summoning sickness.
678-1636-1778-4534.description:
Activate Barrage Ogre by tapping it and sacrificing Memnite.
When Memnite dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Memnite from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Barrage Orge ability, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Repeat.

856-4050-5270.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it and Samwise triggers.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain one life.
Resolve the Samwise trigger, creating a Food token.
Repeat.

1864-2034-4050.manaNeeded: {3}{B}{R}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1864-2034-4050.description:
Cast Prossh from the command zone by paying {3}{B}{R}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Prossh triggers, creating a 0/1 Kobold of Kher Keep token for each mana spent to cast Prossh.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Prossh, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to have Prossh returned to the command zone.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing three Kobold of Kher Keep tokens, adding {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Kobold of Kher Keep token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Prossh.
Repeat from step 1.
